acceso.requisitosContrasena: At least 12 characters, with upper case, lower case and a digit.
acceso.contrasenaTemporal: Your password is temporary. Change it now to continue.

errores.bloqueado: The account is locked after too many failed attempts. Try again later.
errores.contrasenaCaducada: The temporary password has expired. Ask whoever administers for a new one.
errores.camposFaltantes: Fill in the user and the password.
errores.noCoinciden: The two new passwords do not match.
errores.error: It could not be completed. Please try again.

identity.PasswordRequiresDigit: The password needs at least one digit.
identity.PasswordRequiresLower: The password needs at least one lower-case letter.
identity.PasswordRequiresUpper: The password needs at least one upper-case letter.
identity.PasswordMismatch: The current password is not correct.

instrumento.buscarAyuda: Type a name or a symbol
instrumento.nadaEnElCatalogo: Nothing in your catalogue under that name.
instrumento.enLaFuenteAyuda: Pick one and confirm its details before creating it.
instrumento.confirmarTitulo: Confirm the details before creating it
instrumento.confirmarAyuda: Compare them with your statement. They will be saved like this, and can be corrected later.
instrumento.bolsaAyuda: For example XNAS, XNYS, XTSE. It is part of its identity.
instrumento.codigoBrokerAyuda: The one on your statement. For Canadian Fundserv funds it is the ONLY identifier: they have no ISIN and their code does not exist in the price source.
instrumento.isinAyuda: Optional. Its check digit is verified: a typo would not be caught otherwise.
instrumento.faltaBolsa: The exchange is missing. It is part of the instrument's identity: without it, the same value could be created twice.
instrumento.faltanDatos: The symbol or the name is missing.
instrumento.falloAlBuscar: The source could not be searched. Please try again.

posiciones.ayudaLotes: One purchase per line. If you bought several times at different prices, add them all: the average cost comes from the sum.
posiciones.exactitudAyuda: Statements do not always give the date of every purchase. Saying it is approximate beats pretending to know it.
posiciones.compraMalFormada: Check the purchases: a quantity above zero, a cost and a date are needed.
posiciones.ganadoSinApertura: Unknown: the opening has not been declared
posiciones.hoyParcial: only what is known: a position is missing its previous close
posiciones.desdoblamientoTitulo: A split has not been applied
posiciones.desdoblamientoAyuda: The quantity stays as it was and the price is divided, so these figures may be far lower than they are. Check against your statement before deciding.
posiciones.noEncontrada: That position could not be found.
posiciones.cerradaAyuda: It is kept with what it cost, so the history still adds up. It does not count in the totals.
posiciones.hayFechasAproximadas: A purchase has an approximate date: calculations that depend on those dates are approximate.
posiciones.venderAyuda: The sale is spread across every purchase, which is what preserves the average cost. You do not choose which purchase is sold.
posiciones.precioAManoAyuda: It overrides any source: the server will not overwrite it with a market price. It is for instruments that publish no quote.
posiciones.cerrarAyuda: Closing deletes nothing: the position leaves the totals but is kept whole, with its purchases. It can be reopened.
posiciones.borrarAyuda: Only for a position entered by mistake. If it really existed, close it: that keeps what it cost and leaves the cash alone.
posiciones.borrarAviso: The position and its purchases will be deleted. Cash will rise by {{coste}} ({{moneda}}), which is what it cost: if it was entered by mistake, that money never left the account. A position with sales cannot be deleted.
posiciones.reabrirAyuda: It counts in the totals again, with the same purchases.
posiciones.precioInvalido: Type a price above zero and its date.

auditoria.subtitulo: Everything changed in other people's data is recorded here.
auditoria.soloAnadir: This log is append-only: it cannot be edited or deleted, and the database refuses the attempt.
auditoria.soloAjenas: Only changes to other people's data

usuarios.subtitulo: Who has access to the household's data.
usuarios.usuarioAyuda: That is what they sign in with. No spaces or accents; for example, "ana.garcia".
usuarios.esAdminAyuda: They will be able to see and change other people's data, and every change will be recorded under their name.
usuarios.faltanDatos: Enter the name and the sign-in name.
usuarios.unSoloAdministrador: There is only one administrator. If they lose their password, nobody will be able to generate another. It is worth having two.
usuarios.claveAviso: Hand it over in person to {{persona}}. It cannot be shown again: if it is lost, generate another.

preferencias.monedaAyuda: This is the currency your totals are added up in. It does not change what you hold: a stock bought in dollars is still the same, but its value is converted into this currency so it can be added to the rest. Changing it changes no purchase and no price, only the figure they come together in.
preferencias.idiomaAyuda: You can also change it from the header. It is your own preference: other people in the household may have a different one.

cartera.monedaHeredada: Leave it empty to use your profile's currency.
cartera.avisoAjenas: These portfolios are not yours. You can see and change them because you administer, and everything you change will be recorded under your name.
cartera.noEncontrada: That portfolio could not be found.
cartera.subtitulo: Each portfolio is an account, with its own base currency.
cartera.sinCarteras: You don't have any portfolios yet. Create one to get started.
cartera.tipoDeRegistroAyuda: RRSP and REER are the same thing, and so are TFSA and CELI: the name depends on which form you are reading. It groups and presents; it changes no calculation.
cartera.borrarAyuda: The portfolio will be deleted and this cannot be undone.
cartera.borrarConPosiciones: It holds {{total}} position(s), so it cannot be deleted. Archive it: it stops counting and nothing is lost.
cartera.preciosSinNada: No instrument needs a price yet.
cartera.recogerCierreAviso: Today's close, the exchange rates and the portfolio snapshots will be saved. If the markets have not closed yet, today's price is the current one and not the close: it will correct itself tonight, but until then the history will say something that is not true.
cartera.recogerCierreHecho: Close saved: {{guardados}} prices, {{fotos}} snapshots of {{carteras}} portfolios.
cartera.rellenarHistoricoAviso: Five years of closes will be requested from the source, one request per instrument. It takes a few seconds and overwrites nothing that is already stored.
cartera.rellenarHistoricoHecho: History filled: {{nuevos}} new closes, {{yaEstaban}} already there.
cartera.totalesParciales: Prices are missing: these totals are partial.

aviso.rendimientoEsDelActivo: The return is the instrument's own, in {{moneda}} at today's rate.
aviso.datosAjenos: You are looking at someone else's data
aviso.datosAjenosDetalle: This account belongs to {{persona}}. You can see and change it because you administer.
aviso.datosAjenosAuditoria: Everything you change will be recorded under your name, with the old value and the new one.

mercado.demasiadoPronto: Too soon. Wait {{total}} seconds and try again.

movimiento.subtitulo: The money going in and out of this portfolio, and the sales. Sales are not entered here: they are recorded when you sell, because they also reduce the position.
movimiento.sinMovimientos: This portfolio has no movements yet.
movimiento.importeObligatorio: The amount must be greater than zero.

tipos.saldoEnUsd: That is about {{usd}} at the rate of today (1 USD = {{tipo}} {{moneda}}). Informational only.
tipos.borrarPregunta: Delete this movement? It cannot be undone.
tipos.corregirAyuda: There is only one and it is replaced. Enter what you put in in total: what the purchases cost plus the cash.
tipos.saldoNegativo: The balance is negative: the opening is less than what the holdings cost. An opening must be what you put in in total — what the purchases cost plus the cash —, not just the cash there was.
tipos.sinApertura: You have not declared the opening yet: what you had put into this account in total, including what the holdings already there had cost. The balance will start counting from there.
tipos.saldoIncompleto: The balance cannot be taken as good: {{total}} movement(s) have no exchange rate, so part of the money cannot be converted.

movimiento.saldoEnUsd: That is about {{usd}} at the rate of today (1 USD = {{tipo}} {{moneda}}). Informational only.
movimiento.borrarPregunta: Delete this movement? It cannot be undone.
movimiento.corregirAyuda: There is only one and it is replaced. Enter what you put in in total: what the purchases cost plus the cash.
movimiento.saldoNegativo: The balance is negative: the opening is less than what the holdings cost. An opening must be what you put in in total — what the purchases cost plus the cash —, not just the cash there was.
movimiento.sinApertura: You have not declared the opening yet: what you had put into this account in total, including what the holdings already there had cost. The balance will start counting from there.
movimiento.saldoIncompleto: The balance cannot be taken as good: {{total}} movement(s) have no exchange rate, so part of the money cannot be converted.
movimiento.invalid_amount: The amount must be greater than zero.
movimiento.invalid: That movement cannot be recorded. For a sale, use the position's sell.

informe.evolucionSubtitulo: What the portfolio is worth and what had been put in, over time. The gap between the two lines is what you have made.
informe.evolucionSinElegir: Choose a portfolio to see its evolution.
informe.evolucionReconstruida: Rebuilt from the movements, closes and exchange rates: it was not recorded day by day.
informe.evolucionDeFotos: From the stored snapshots: this is what was recorded, day by day.
informe.evolucionParcial: Partial: the price of {{instrumentos}} is missing, so that stretch is below what it was.
informe.evolucionEtiqueta: Evolution of the portfolio value and of what was put in
informe.subtitulo: What each portfolio is worth, what it cost, what has been contributed and what has already been sold. Filterable by person and by registration type.
informe.avisoEfectivo: This report measures holdings. The application keeps no cash account, so uninvested money does not appear in the value.
informe.ganadoSinApertura: Unknown: the opening has not been declared
informe.realizadaDesconocida: unknown, a sale is missing its cost
informe.aportadoDesconocido: unknown, a movement is missing its exchange rate
informe.sinFilas: No portfolios to show with those filters.
informe.sinFoto: that portfolio has no snapshot for the day yet

portfolio.not_found: That portfolio could not be found.
portfolio.invalid_currency: That currency is not valid. Use a three-letter code, such as CAD.
portfolio.registration_required: Choose the registration type: RRSP, TFSA or non-registered.
portfolio.has_positions: That portfolio has positions, so it cannot be deleted. Archive it: it stops counting and nothing is lost.

position.has_sales: That position has sales, so it cannot be deleted: a sale is a fact and its realised gain would be lost. Undo the whole sale first.

grafico.repartoParcial: A position has no price: the breakdown is of what is known.
grafico.sinDatos: There is no data to draw yet.
